Hamari Kahani

Zaiqa jo yaad reh jaye

Spice & Smoke ek demo restaurant hai jahan purani Lahori recipes ko aaj ke andaz mein pesh kiya jata hai. Hamari nihari raat bhar ki halki aanch par pakti hai, biryani mein asli dum ka zaiqa hai, aur kebab hamesha koylo ki aag par siktey hain.

Family dinner ho ya doston ki mehfil — saaf suthra mahaul, garam khana aur mehmaan-nawazi hamari pehchan hai.
